items.why: Free plan Notetaker went from "Limited Notetaker access (Mac, Windows, iPhone)" to unlimited meetings with 30-day desktop history; the iPhone addition in the same week is a feature add and not the kept change.

record.short: Free plan Notetaker access goes from limited to unlimited meetings with 30-day meeting history on desktop.
record.headline: Wispr Flow lifted the cap on Notetaker meetings for Free users and now shows a 30-day meeting history on desktop.
rows: Unlimited meetings · 30-day meeting history on desktop
record.who: Free plan users; Pro already had unlimited Notetaker meetings, so the gap between the plans on this limit has closed.
record.read: A more generous free tier lowers the cost of trying Notetaker and shifts what Pro has to offer beyond meeting volume. The exact old cap was never shown, so the size of the loosening can't be measured.
record.caveat: The previous limit was described only as "Limited", with no number, so the size of the change is unknown.

items.why: Qwen4 Max list price rose from $1.43/$0.0713/$4.28 to $1.50/$0.075/$4.50 per 1M tokens one day after the model was listed; a limited-time discounted rate runs to 11/23/2026 and Tencent Hy4 was added.

record.short: Qwen4 Max list price rises from $1.43 input and $4.28 output to $1.50 input and $4.50 output per 1M tokens.
record.deltaSub: Qwen4 Max output price, per 1M tokens
record.headline: Together raised the list price of Qwen4 Max one day after listing it, while showing a limited-time discounted rate until 11/23/2026.
rows: Qwen4 Max cached input, per 1M tokens
Limited-time discounted output rate, per 1M tokens
record.who: Anyone paying per token for Qwen4 Max on Together's serverless inference; the model was only listed the day before.
record.read: Repricing a model within a day of launch suggests the launch price was provisional. The temporary discount makes the effective price lower until it ends, so the real cost after the window depends on whether the list price holds.
record.caveat: A limited-time discounted rate ($1.05 input, $0.0525 cached, $3.15 output) is shown until 11/23/2026, so the effective price is lower until then. Together also added Tencent Hy4 at $0.83 input and $2.50 output per 1M tokens in the same capture.

items.why: Slackbot row on the comparison table went from "Consumption based" to not included for Free and Pro, and the Enterprise+ claim changed from "Unlimited Slackbot" to "Slackbot with no weekly message limits"; the page appears to be running an experiment.

record.short: Slackbot goes from "Consumption based" to not included on Free and Pro, and the Enterprise+ "Unlimited Slackbot" line is reworded.
record.headline: Slack's pricing page stopped listing Slackbot on Free and Pro, reversing the usage-limited access it showed days earlier, and softened the Enterprise+ "unlimited" claim.
rows: Slackbot with no weekly message limits
record.who: Free and Pro users who had Slackbot access; Enterprise+ customers see only a wording change with added usage-guideline caveats.
record.read: If it holds, Slackbot becomes a paid-tier feature, which fits a pattern of AI assistants being gated up the ladder. The page has been flipping in recent days, so this may not be the final state.
record.caveat: The page appears to run a live experiment script and the Slackbot and Enterprise+ details have changed repeatedly over recent days, so this may be one arm of a test rather than a decided change.
